rationale: No evidence-supported optimization fits this workflow while preserving coverage and meeting preconditions. The workflow already uses path-filtered triggers (P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER already satisfied), so no trigger filter change is needed. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST does not apply because there is a single job and no matrix to cancel. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE does not apply because there is no dependency download/install step to cache (g++ is runner-provided; no npm/pip/apt). P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT is the closest candidate (the job has no timeout-minutes), but its precondition requires representative successful-duration history, and the repository CI history shows only failures with measurement marked not_a_measured_baseline, so an informed safe timeout cannot be set and a valid slow build could be falsely terminated. Schedule-based, Bazel, test-selection, and test-prioritization patterns are irrelevant (no schedule, no Bazel, single test step).
